speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to begin my assessment, have these symptoms been present for months or years, and do they appear bilaterally on both hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (specifically Cutaneous Leishmaniasis with potential visceral involvement given the neurologic symptoms).
REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear, Complete_Blood_Count, Liver_Function_Tests.
REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_biopsy_images showing amastigotes.
